investigation: RC5 preflight — why physical device may show RC3 while RC4 was reported shipped

rc3.scope: Session resilience, network retry, reviews UI, unified nav — NO commerce interaction audit

rc4.scope: PR #139 — cart, favorites, catalog filters, seller nav, profile IA, update downgrade protection

physicalObservation.conclusion: Device screenshots indicate RC3 was running, not RC4

likelyReasonOldVersionRemained.evidence: Beta banner on device shows versionCode 7 (RC3), not 8 (RC4)
GET /api/mobile/update?versionCode=7&channel=CLOSED_BETA returns updateState=NO_UPDATE, latest versionCode=6 (RC2 only)
download-apk.ts uses Linking.openURL only — opens browser; does not invoke Android package installer; telemetry previously falsely reported 'downloaded' before handoff
Android requires user confirmation for APK sideload; download completing in browser does not equal app update

autoUpdateImplementation.apkUrlSource: MRP BETA channel latest published release downloadUrl
autoUpdateImplementation.verdict: Download handoff only — NOT automatic install. User must manually open downloaded APK and confirm Android install dialog.

verifyInstalledVersionOnAndroid.method1: Open app → Profile → О приложении → check versionName, versionCode, commit SHA
verifyInstalledVersionOnAndroid.method3: adb shell dumpsys package ru.lot.marketplace.alpha | grep versionCode
verifyInstalledVersionOnAndroid.method4: Settings → Apps → ЛОТ → App info → version

classification.explanation: Physical device ran RC3 (pre-PR#139). In-app update could not deliver RC4 because MRP only publishes RC2 (code 6), which is older than installed code 7. Automated tests claimed fixes without runtime proof.
